title: Al-Inshiqaq hifdh test and sifat check: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Inshiqaq and the sifat of strength
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 17 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Inshiqaq hifdh test and sifat check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 17. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Two sifat the teacher listens for
points: Breath on ت with sukoon: ٱنشَقَّتْ
Bounce on ق or د: أُقْسِمُ, كَدْحًا

head: Not this
This
rows: After وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ (84:2), going straight to 84:6
84:2 is followed by 84:3 (وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ); 84:5 is followed by 84:6

panels.title: Break plan
points: Day 3: rota surah; tick the log

keywords.def: the qualities of a letter's sound (singular sifah)

questions.q: Self-check: recite 84:1 to 6 to yourself and score each rubric row.
questions.a: Pupil scores each row 2 to 4 and writes one target.

questions.q: Hifdh test: recite Al-Inshiqaq (or the part the teacher chooses) to the teacher one by one. While waiting, revise in breakout pairs.
questions.a: Teacher records rubric scores and a target for each pupil in the portal; pupils heard this week in the rota keep that score.

questions.q: Extend: write your break plan on the pupil PDF.
questions.a: 10 minutes a day, surahs by day, log ticked.

questions.q: Stretch: name the sifat of ق in four words.
questions.a: Jahr, shiddah, isti'la, and qalqalah when it has sukoon.
A) وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ. 84:3: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ. 84:6 begins يَٰٓأَيُّهَا, which follows the repeated 84:5.

questions.q: Best way to keep hifdh in Ramadan?
Think again: What helped you most this half term to memorise 25 ayat? What will you keep doing in Ramadan?
questions.a: Chunking, the listening rota and daily revision; keep 10 minutes a day through the break.
